Subject: Intro / schedule - Infra Coverage (replacement)

Hi Marissa and Markus,

Per our convo last week, I have a strong inbound for the infra coverage backfill (replacement for Rohan). Candidate is Alex Tan — previously in SRE at a mid‑sized AI infra shop. Quick snapshot attached (resume).

Proposed interview plan (short cycle, two days):
- Day 1: 45m technical screen with Markus (system design + reliability)
- Day 2: 30m cross‑functional with Marissa (team fit + SLAs), 30m manager loop with Markus

Availability from Alex: Jan 12–14 mornings PST. Can you confirm slots? I can coordinate calendar invites and send a short prep note.

Best,

- I have hands-on with KV caching and production rolling upgrades (GKE, bare metal).

Happy to send any additional material. Looking forward to the conversation.

— Alex

From: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: rebecca.sims <rebecca.sims@recruiters.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 13:55:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate debrief: Alex Tan — recommendation to open req

Hi all,

We completed the loop today. Quick debrief and ask below.

Summary of interviews (notes attached):
- Tech screen: Alex demonstrated solid ownership on KV cache invalidation patterns; clearly has experience with large token-serving infra.
- System design: Good tradeoffs between latency/cost; suggested a sensible KV sharding approach that aligns with our runtime.
- Team fit: Engaged, pragmatic, asks good clarifying questions about SLOs and operational runbooks.

Recommendation: Strong hire for the infra coverage role. We should move to extend an offer, but before that we need an approved requisition to proceed (HR needs a req number to issue an offer and for alignment with Dedicated budget).

Request: Marissa — can you approve opening the replacement req (Level: Senior SRE / Infra Engineer, comp band: S3) and confirm funding source (there's remaining committed headcount from Rohan's backfill). If you approve, Laura — please generate req and post to Greenhouse.

Attachments: interview_notes_infra_team_01-13.docx

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Infra

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, rebecca.sims <rebecca.sims@recruiters.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate debrief: Alex Tan — recommendation to open req

Thanks for the quick debrief, Markus — good writeup.

Approval: I approve opening the replacement requisition for the Senior SRE / Infra Engineer (S3). We will use the existing backfill allocation from Rohan's headcount; finance confirmed remaining budget during Q4 forecasting.

Operational notes:
- Laura: please create the req (use tag "replacement-Rohan-2026") and post to Greenhouse, capturing the comp range as S3. Fast track the requisition — Rebecca, you can proceed with extending verbal offer once req is in the system.
- Mina: please add the role to the EMEA hiring freeze exception list if needed; region is US but coordination required for relocation.

Marissa
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
